theorem extractedOldExprInVars :
  NormalizedOldExpr post →
  (extractOldExprVars post).Subset
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars post) := by
  have sap : ∀ {l₁ l₂ r₁ r₂ : List Expression.Ident},
      l₁.Subset r₁ → l₂.Subset r₂ → (l₁ ++ l₂).Subset (r₁ ++ r₂) := by
    intros _ _ _ _ h₁ h₂ x hx
    exact List.mem_append.mpr ((List.mem_append.mp hx).imp (fun h => h₁ h) (fun h => h₂ h))
  intro Hnorm
  induction Hnorm
  case app h ih₁ ih₂ =>
    unfold extractOldExprVars
    split
    · exact fun _ m => m
    · next Hx => cases h IsOldPred.oldPred; exact (Hx _ _ _ rfl).elim
    · exact sap ih₁ ih₂
  all_goals
    simp_all [extractOldExprVars, Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars,
      Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars, sap]
